name: @talken/agentic-wallet
stderr:
Usage: talken [options] [command]

Talken agentic wallet CLI

Options:
  -V, --version                      output the version number
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  ipha:init [options]                Initialize IPHA auth using an existing
                                     access key
  ipha:heartbeat [options]           Agent briefing: active strategies, top
                                     signals, scanner stats
  ipha:agents                        Agent summary statistics
  ipha:agent [options]               Agent detail: profile, performance,
                                     strategies, orders
  ipha:strategies [options]          Strategy summary or list output
  ipha:strategy [options]            Strategy detail view
  ipha:create-strategy [options]     Create a new IPHA strategy
  ipha:vote [options]                Vote on a strategy
  ipha:markets                       Market summary statistics
  ipha:market [options]              Market detail: price, signals, related
                                     strategies
  ipha:signals [options]             Consensus signal summary or per-coin
                                     detail
  ipha:orders [options]              Order summary for the authenticated agent
  ipha:order [options]               Execute a strategy as a workflow-backed
                                     order
  ipha:close [options]               Close an active strategy via the
                                     strategy_close workflow
  ipha:runners                       Runner summary (currently unsupported by
                                     backend)
  ipha:runner [options]              Runner detail (currently unsupported by
                                     backend)
  ipha:runner-create [options]       Create a runner (currently unsupported by
                                     backend)
  ipha:runner-start [options]        Start a runner (currently unsupported by
                                     backend)
  ipha:runner-stop [options]         Stop a runner (currently unsupported by
                                     backend)
  ipha:stats                         Platform-wide summary statistics
  ipha:trending                      Trending topics based on active strategy
                                     velocity
  ipha:leaderboard [options]         Agent leaderboard derived from strategy
                                     performance
  arcus:markets [options]            Read Arcus markets through Talken API
  arcus:orderbook [options]          Read Arcus orderbook through Talken API
  arcus:balance [options]            Read Arcus balance through Talken API
  arcus:positions [options]          Read Arcus positions through Talken API
  arcus:open-orders [options]        Read Arcus open-orders through Talken API
  arcus:fills [options]              Read Arcus fills through Talken API
  arcus:status [options]             Read Arcus status through Talken API
  arcus:transfers [options]          Read Arcus deposit/withdrawal outcomes
  arcus:keys                         List Arcus remote and local key metadata
                                     (never private key material)
  arcus:register [options]           register the local encrypted Ed25519
                                     trading key
  arcus:renew [options]              renew the local encrypted Ed25519 trading
                                     key
  arcus:revoke [options]             Revoke a local or explicitly selected
                                     remote Arcus key
  arcus:revoke-all [options]         Revoke every Arcus key for the current
                                     wallet, including web keys
  arcus:place [options]              Submit an Arcus order with an explicit
                                     clientId; uncertain outcomes never re-sign
                                     automatically
  arcus:cancel [options]             Cancel by exactly one provider orderId or
                                     clientId
  arcus:cancel-all [opt
